verdict.pick: Amazon Basics 13.2‑Gallon Rectangle Soft‑Close Trash Can
verdict.line: Buy this if you want solid odor containment and a low price; its soft‑close lid and 13‑gallon capacity keep smells in and fit most kitchen counters. The catch is it lacks any smart sealing or sensor features.
